Trim ASGR if it's purely a proxy; hold SNPS for semiconductor design tailwinds.

sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's renewable energy mandate (RUPTL 2025-2034) is accelerating domestic demand for solar, EV, and biomass assets, structurally favoring local champions like TOBA and VKTR over US peers.

Geothermal and waste-to-energy projects are gaining policy priority under the new government's energy security push, underpinning sustained upside for BRPT and CDIA as long-term contracted cash flows.

The divergence between ID (+3.34%) and US (-0.47%) reflects capital rotation into emerging-market climate plays, driven by favorable rupiah stability and lower financing costs for domestic green infra
sectors.ai: Buy dips in TOBA, VKTR, and POWR on confirmed volume; the ID rally signals domestic policy tailwinds, while US weakness is a transient rotation. Trim TPIA if it fails to hold +4% support. Rebalance toward CDIA and BRPT for geothermal and biomass exposure. Maintain WATCH; add on any 3% pullback in the aggregate index within 10 sessions.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Indonesia's middle-class consumption upgrade continues to drive premium FMCG and specialty retail volumes, favoring names with local production and distribution moats over import-dependent peers.
Regulatory tailwinds for domestic food security and halal certification are consolidating market share toward established Indonesian brands, creating durable pricing power and margin expansion.
The shift toward digital-native distribution and direct-to-consumer channels in tier-2/3 cities is unlocking new demand pools, disproportionately benefiting agile, locally listed consumer companies.
sectors.ai: Buy selective Indonesian consumer names on domestic momentum, not the index: BIKE, CBUT, and POLU show strong local catalysts (new listings, earnings beats, or distribution wins) while US-linked names drag. Rotate into high-beta FMCG with clear volume growth and avoid names with USD cost exposure. Trim into strength if IDX consumer breadth weakens below 50% advancers.
